contract: Shutdown closes admission and resolves only when no active attempt and no scheduled retry can later start. Retry timers are request work, not unrelated maintenance timers. Cancelling a timer removes it from the owned pending set. Shutdown does not require successful completion of cancelled requests.

expectedFindings.symptom: A failed attempt schedules a retry at time10 and leaves active count zero.
expectedFindings.source: A failed attempt schedules a retry at time10 and leaves active count zero. Shutdown sees no active work and resolves. The pending timer fires after resolution and starts another attempt unless closed admission is checked/cancelled. A drain over both active and owned timers plus cancellation prevents post-drain admission.
expectedFindings.consequence: The supplied contract is violated in the bounded driver schedule; no production impact or permanent leakage is established.
expectedFindings.remedy: Close admission before inspecting owned work, cancel scheduled retries, and gate every retry callback on closed admission before starting another attempt.

evidenceRequirements.description: Establish any valid causal witness from the supplied code and context; exact driver numbers/order are not required. A drain over both active and owned timers plus cancellation prevents post-drain admission.

Explain at least one relevant boundary or benign path inferable from the supplied code/context; the following evaluator examples are alternatives, not a mandatory unseen checklist: Normal retry before shutdown remains allowed; shutdown with an active attempt waits for settlement; repeated shutdown is idempotent; a timer already dequeued before close is still rejected by the admission gate.
